C4.statement: For every delta>0 and every Hellinger-compact P contained in P_{M,d}, the total-variation minimax squared risk lies between epsilon_n^{2(1+(2+delta)/log(log(1/epsilon_n) vee e))} and epsilon_n^2, up to constants, where epsilon_n is the Jia local-Hellinger-entropy rate.
quantifiers: every Hellinger-compact P subset of P_{M,d}
C4.pass_condition: Reconstruct the upper and lower minimax implications, including estimator projection, the imported Jia Fano event, monotonic inversion of J, and the exact target exponent.

C5.statement: Under epsilon-Huber contamination of P_{M,d}, the proper Yatracos estimator has squared-Hellinger risk bounded by epsilon^{2(1-(2+delta)/log(log(1/epsilon) vee e))}+n^{-1+o_d(1)}, and every estimator has the stated 0.33 lower rate in epsilon.
quantifiers: all sufficiently small epsilon and sufficiently large n
C5.pass_condition: Reconstruct the proper-estimator upper bound and a uniform-in-epsilon Chen two-point lower bound, not merely a finite estimator experiment or a discrete sharpness subsequence.
